name: Happy Set: Decidueye & Melmetal & Koraidon & Miraidon (Happy Pack)

line.name: Happy Set: Decidueye & Melmetal & Koraidon & Miraidon

releases.name: Happy Set: Decidueye & Melmetal & Koraidon & Miraidon (Happy Pack)

description.text: The Happy Pack (嗨皮包) is a two-card pack that was new in the Happy Set Decidueye & Melmetal & Koraidon & Miraidon of 10 April 2026, seven to a box, shared out after the games by the number of games won. Its 49 cards, 43 Pokémon and three cards each of the Supporters Black Belt's Training and Professor's Research, come as non-holo cards (88.45% of cards), Poké Ball pattern holos (10.50%) and Master Ball pattern holos (1.05%). A pack holds at most one of the cards numbered 044 to 049, the Supporters. They are numbered out of 49.
